name: last30days
tagline_zh: 过日子用得上：last30days。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Research what people actually say about any topic in the last 30 days. Pulls posts and engagement from Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, Hacker News, Polymarket, GitHub, and the web. Includes a doctor health check to diagnose broken or missing sources.
unshelve_reason: 红线 · 绕反爬 + 抽取用户凭据。首跑向导**从用户浏览器抽取 X 的登录 cookie**，用仓库内 vendored 的 Twitter 私有 GraphQL 接口发请求，CHANGELOG 明写重试是为了处理 X 的 anti-bot 拦截页。判据同 D20：目的正当与如实披露都不豁免行为本身。
